title: Field widgets: Tags, Lookup and People act on an Enter pressed while an input method is composing
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTC8kn7AdeMpMmyhJG

Filing gate: ④ child of the coordination parent #35683 (list inline-edit redo). Source: the contract review of PR #35747 (record 7034067196, nit N3), which the seat ruled filed as its own card.

## What is left

PR #35747 makes the list grid ignore keys pressed while an input method is composing (`isComposing`, or keyCode 229), so a Chinese pinyin user's Enter that picks a word no longer commits the cell. That guard belongs to the table's own key handlers. Field widgets that read Enter themselves still act on it during a composition, in the grid's editors and on the record form alike. Read at PR #35747 head `fb141148` (pre-existing on main):

- `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/TagsField.tsx` (near :65) adds the draft as a tag on Enter or comma.
- Enter in the search box of `LookupField` and of `PeoplePicker` picks the highlighted entry.

## Why

A user typing Chinese, Japanese or Korean into a tags field, or into a lookup's or people picker's search, presses Enter to pick a word from the input method. Today that Enter also adds half-typed pinyin as a tag, or picks whatever entry is highlighted. The user has to undo it and type again.

## Done when

- In each of the three widgets, an Enter (or the tag field's comma) pressed during a composition does only what the input method does with it; the widget acts on the next Enter after the composition ends.
- One shared helper is used (the grid's `isImeKey` from #35747, or one exported beside it), not three copies.
- Pins per widget with a real composition sequence (compositionstart, keydown Enter with `isComposing: true` and keyCode 229, compositionend); a check in Chromium with a real composition event, and Safari's post-composition 229 Enter pinned.

Grading: area:ux · Bug · p2 · reach: users who type through an input method into tags, lookups or people pickers · evidence: read on the PR #35747 branch at `fb141148`; the L2 record 7034067196, N3.

Reader: the seat's next area thread for epic #35683, or the `domain:ui` lane.

Dedupe: `TagsField` (objectstack issues, open) → 0; `isComposing` open → 2 (#35684, #35687, the grid's own guard); `IME composition Enter` open → the same 2.
